b: ^Uus nägu. Kvissentali on väike koht, siin märgatakse.
^en: A new face. Kvissentali is a small place, people notice.
^en: What are you looking for here?

menu: ^Kaev on veel alles. %% The well is still here.
^Anna pookoksad. %% Hand over the grafting stock.
^Kas siin õunapuid on? %% Are there apple trees here?
^Kust see lehekülg pärit on? %% Where is that page from?
^Värav põllu serval. %% The gate at the field's edge.
^Kivi maamärgi juures. %% The stone by the landmark.
^Mis koht see on? %% What is this place?

c-0: ^Magus vesi. Vanad ütlesid, et see oleks peaaegu täis aetud. Keegi aitas.
^en: Sweet water. The old people said it was nearly filled in. Somebody helped.
c-1: ^Kirjutasin ühe kirja. Kellele, ei tea. Panin sinna, kus keegi selle kord leiab.
^en: I wrote one letter. To whom, I don't know. I put it where somebody will find it one day.
c-2: ^Need on vanemad kui mina. Ja veel elus.
^en: These are older than I am. And still alive.
^Põllu serv. Homme hommikul. Enne kui keegi ütleb, et ei tasu.
^en: The edge of the field. Tomorrow morning. Before anyone says it is not worth it.
c-3: ^Ei. Vanad räägivad, et mõisal oli pookoksi. Kadusid koos mõisaga.
^en: No. The old people say the manor had grafting stock. It went with the manor.
c-4: ^Vanast raamatust. Keegi rebis välja, keegi hoidis alles. Meie nimi on seal, aga kellele seda näidata.
^en: From an old book. Somebody tore it out, somebody kept it. Our name is on it, but who is there to show it to.
c-5: ^Piir on kirjas. Alati oli. Sellepärast värav veel seisab.
^en: The boundary is written. Always was. That is why the gate still stands.
c-6: ^Keegi pani selle sinna ammu. Nimi on veel peal. Meie omad hoidsid seda puhtana.
^en: Somebody set it there long ago. The name is still on it. Our people kept it clean.
c-7: ^Kvissentali. Kõik, mis siin on, seisab millegi vanema peal.
^en: Kvissentali. Everything here stands on something older.
